title: Wall Street ends higher as traders return to AI stocks
article_content: Wall Street rose on Monday as investors rotated into AI-related equities, with tech names leading the gains. The rally was driven by enthusiasm around artificial intelligence deployment and its impact on earnings prospects, with AI-related stocks contributing to a broader tech-led rebound and market optimism.

additional_sources.title: This AI stock is surging on a deal with Meta. Citi says it can go much higher.
additional_sources.article_content: This AI stock is the biggest mover of the day on a deal with Meta. Citi says it can go much higher. The article discusses how AI-related deals and deployment optimism support gains in AI stocks, contributing to a broad market rally.

market_context_source.title: AI stock rally broadens as more companies increase AI investments
market_context_source.article_content: Market context shows a broader AI investment cycle lifting multiple sectors beyond tech, as corporate AI deployments, cloud infrastructure spending, and AI-enabled productivity gains shape earnings expectations and drive equity flows.
